description: This Dart source file defines the AuthGate widget, which manages authentication state by listening to AuthState and conditionally displaying either the SignInPage or MainTabs based on whether the user is signed in.

classes.name: AuthGate
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that observes authentication state and displays the appropriate page: SignInPage if not signed in, or MainTabs if signed in.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, utilizing an AnimatedSwitcher to transition between SignInPage and MainTabs based on authentication state.
